notes.type_correctness: All components use TypeScript strictly. CSSProperties used correctly for CSS custom property glide variables. No implicit any. tsc --noEmit exits clean.
notes.pattern_adherence: One deviation found and fixed: companion product h3 label was 'The mobile remote' instead of the brief-mandated 'your phone'. All other sections follow established Reveal/ProductFrame/shadcn Button patterns. Tailwind tokens throughout — no arbitrary color values.
notes.test_coverage: All 208 tests pass across 36 test files. Tests cover headline copy, CTA hrefs, section IDs, and component rendering. Minor gap: no test verifies that AgentsSection, FeaturesSection, CommandsSection and PrinciplesSection are absent from Index; but the implementation is clearly correct by reading Index.tsx.
notes.security: Companion link has rel='noopener noreferrer' and target='_blank'. Hash-based scroll in Index uses a sanitizing allowlist regex to prevent CSS selector injection. No new attack surface.
notes.architectural_alignment: Index.tsx collapses to exactly 6 sections (Hero, Pipeline, Demo, Problem, Products, Footer) as specified. SECTION_IDS matches the brief's IA. No backend calls added. The ApiMcpSection and HubShowcaseSection components remain as unreferenced files — their unique content (MCP server setup, Hub showcase) is not reachable via any route, but this is pre-existing orphan status not introduced by this change.
